stem: What is the sum of all integers \(x\) that satisfy \(-7 \le 3 - 2x < 5\)?
solution: Divide by \(-2\) and reverse both signs: \(5 \ge x > -1\), that is, \(-1 < x \le 5\).
The integers are 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5, and their sum is 15.
verify:
sols = [n for n in range(-50, 50) if -7 <= 3 - 2*n < 5]
assert sols == [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
assert [Rational(a) for a in spr_answers] == [sum(sols)]
